يجتور (form VIII)
# يَجْتَوِرُ (yajtawiru) /jad͡ʒ.ta.wi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَوَرَ (ijtawara)
# يُجْتَوَرُ (yujtawaru) /jud͡ʒ.ta.wa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَوَرَ (ijtawara)
# يَجْتَوِرَ (yajtawira) /jad͡ʒ.ta.wi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَوَرَ (ijtawara)
